scope: platform-level security audit for the Task 111 additions (LLM-specific audit: task111_llm_security_audit.json)

credentials.in_frontend: none — provider calls are server-side only
credentials.in_logs: never printed; provider log records metadata only

external_transmission.payload: structured evidence packages only (no DB dumps, no user PII, no broker data, no licensed-feed redistribution)

prompt_injection: news/filings treated as untrusted evidence; sanitizer + detector + system-prompt guard; flagged items never trusted
output_validation: strict server-side schema validation before any signal is stored or displayed
api_authorization: new routes are read-only research endpoints; no order execution exists behind any route
rate_limits: 12h disk cache per source/symbol; bounded retrieval
retention: artifacts committed under data/backtest_reports/task111/ for auditability
